Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 47, "heading": "CHAPTER 45. MR. DICK FULFILS MY AUNT’S PREDICTIONS", "previous_rows": [], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 45, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u047-h", "tag": "h2", "role": "heading", "text": "CHAPTER 45. MR. DICK FULFILS MY AUNT’S PREDICTIONS", "sha256": "8fd5cfc597c445dc409f8278a87aefd8130a36bc49c91d97f64158a7b9e97d1d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/h2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0001", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was some time now, since I had left the Doctor. Living in his neighbourhood, I saw him frequently; and we all went to his house on two or three occasions to dinner or tea. The Old Soldier was in permanent quarters under the Doctor’s roof. She was exactly the same as ever, and the same immortal butterflies hovered over her cap.", "sha256": "2ece3e1afb80b624f25d4e3c1e168cc60a45930a0252ce8c52d2918a353b623b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[1]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0002", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Like some other mothers, whom I have known in the course of my life, Mrs. Markleham was far more fond of pleasure than her daughter was. She required a great deal of amusement, and, like a deep old soldier, pretended, in consulting her own inclinations, to be devoting herself to her child. The Doctor’s desire that Annie should be entertained, was therefore particularly acceptable to this excellent parent; who expressed unqualified approval of his discretion.", "sha256": "06d0027d6a0acf9240e814c8698e7133c078656ea192a11cf0a4c559341aa91d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[2]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0003", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I have no doubt, indeed, that she probed the Doctor’s wound without knowing it. Meaning nothing but a certain matured frivolity and selfishness, not always inseparable from full-blown years, I think she confirmed him in his fear that he was a constraint upon his young wife, and that there was no congeniality of feeling between them, by so strongly commending his design of lightening the load of her life.", "sha256": "43e8de149c75fe4b085b1529cfa83bc4f7b00d98d81de9c02d64e9e8862d544c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[3]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0004", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My dear soul,’ she said to him one day when I was present, ‘you know there is no doubt it would be a little pokey for Annie to be always shut up here.’", "sha256": "b3cf732f08350acf6536978a8620c3fe8aaf5abaed0bbc50973310a2dd056435", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[4]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0005", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The Doctor nodded his benevolent head. ‘When she comes to her mother’s age,’ said Mrs. Markleham, with a flourish of her fan, ‘then it’ll be another thing. You might put ME into a Jail, with genteel society and a rubber, and I should never care to come out. But I am not Annie, you know; and Annie is not her mother.’", "sha256": "8e83b63801bee34080bac6a8564bdb4eca0acaefd8721c2ca6f82daac58bddc3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[5]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0006", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Surely, surely,’ said the Doctor.", "sha256": "5a8ace8b4fb1c8ae3429dbe46f80d023957e52b175517e60b44a016082f0f545", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[6]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0007", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You are the best of creatures—no, I beg your pardon!’ for the Doctor made a gesture of deprecation, ‘I must say before your face, as I always say behind your back, you are the best of creatures; but of course you don’t—now do you?—-enter into the same pursuits and fancies as Annie?’", "sha256": "05feae6a6733eac6b261efc3ca32862a8a2400b0de719f397d26614e47d4422d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[7]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0008", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No,’ said the Doctor, in a sorrowful tone.", "sha256": "8a6ebc8755ccd3c2e74ee844152ae5b7ce9a538ba106add79de13568a646a3e4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[8]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0009", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, of course not,’ retorted the Old Soldier. ‘Take your Dictionary, for example. What a useful work a Dictionary is! What a necessary work! The meanings of words! Without Doctor Johnson, or somebody of that sort, we might have been at this present moment calling an Italian-iron, a bedstead. But we can’t expect a Dictionary—especially when it’s making—to interest Annie, can we?’", "sha256": "37eb526f0d88702466b10207925a943991d0210ad6c5ba55ba1aadc91a01dc2e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[9]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0010", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The Doctor shook his head.", "sha256": "76e736fd0e3a79b8ceaea3c95931f54bc864fb1df98bf68a12bfe86496fc3c1e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[10]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0011", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And that’s why I so much approve,’ said Mrs. Markleham, tapping him on the shoulder with her shut-up fan, ‘of your thoughtfulness. It shows that you don’t expect, as many elderly people do expect, old heads on young shoulders. You have studied Annie’s character, and you understand it. That’s what I find so charming!’", "sha256": "911541f6fb92782ae8a2558d84d1c661e4c5a5e8d741750f7bfcf5b452de0cf5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[11]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0012", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Even the calm and patient face of Doctor Strong expressed some little sense of pain, I thought, under the infliction of these compliments.", "sha256": "4163b563c2390113f5c48ef1ef2ea5432a6a96f550f543e82a716a5405afa978", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[12]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0013", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Therefore, my dear Doctor,’ said the Old Soldier, giving him several affectionate taps, ‘you may command me, at all times and seasons. Now, do understand that I am entirely at your service. I am ready to go with Annie to operas, concerts, exhibitions, all kinds of places; and you shall never find that I am tired. Duty, my dear Doctor, before every consideration in the universe!’", "sha256": "112015c88935251ffcd3416a246fa5461689012caff0c3d3a10c77f9e9bd20b5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[13]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0014", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She was as good as her word. She was one of those people who can bear a great deal of pleasure, and she never flinched in her perseverance in the cause. She seldom got hold of the newspaper (which she settled herself down in the softest chair in the house to read through an eye-glass, every day, for two hours), but she found out something that she was certain Annie would like to see. It was in vain for Annie to protest that she was weary of such things. Her mother’s remonstrance always was, ‘Now, my dear Annie, I am sure you know better; and I must tell you, my love, that you are not making a proper return for the kindness of Doctor Strong.’", "sha256": "35c008becff9e8d0b6364b224fa45fc71b062af2be247b4777e269e9bfe3f68e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[14]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0015", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "This was usually said in the Doctor’s presence, and appeared to me to constitute Annie’s principal inducement for withdrawing her objections when she made any. But in general she resigned herself to her mother, and went where the Old Soldier would.", "sha256": "249141690c14d9f8e401742b61eac3600579eea11e3e7fc5cd03e92f52f0c94f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[15]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0016", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It rarely happened now that Mr. Maldon accompanied them. Sometimes my aunt and Dora were invited to do so, and accepted the invitation. Sometimes Dora only was asked. The time had been, when I should have been uneasy in her going; but reflection on what had passed that former night in the Doctor’s study, had made a change in my mistrust. I believed that the Doctor was right, and I had no worse suspicions.", "sha256": "4c7d256262aa2332469a433aa093429120a1ff9c5dd14f1efb2dc692e0f12fb9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[16]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0017", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My aunt rubbed her nose sometimes when she happened to be alone with me, and said she couldn’t make it out; she wished they were happier; she didn’t think our military friend (so she always called the Old Soldier) mended the matter at all. My aunt further expressed her opinion, ‘that if our military friend would cut off those butterflies, and give ‘em to the chimney-sweepers for May-day, it would look like the beginning of something sensible on her part.’", "sha256": "8c379ba740685a4eb494f5afb7afb1943295293d731efb24fd0b742285719767", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[17]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0018", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "But her abiding reliance was on Mr. Dick. That man had evidently an idea in his head, she said; and if he could only once pen it up into a corner, which was his great difficulty, he would distinguish himself in some extraordinary manner.", "sha256": "df39a5e485c77b0062a57def12e4b449e01523d68f94d4c681bbc67d322bb8bd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[18]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0019", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Unconscious of this prediction, Mr. Dick continued to occupy precisely the same ground in reference to the Doctor and to Mrs. Strong. He seemed neither to advance nor to recede. He appeared to have settled into his original foundation, like a building; and I must confess that my faith in his ever Moving, was not much greater than if he had been a building.", "sha256": "d48e099fe20f0456296e0f794e3e82b63f7df181e525f2afa46c212a084e9d01", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[19]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0020", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "But one night, when I had been married some months, Mr. Dick put his head into the parlour, where I was writing alone (Dora having gone out with my aunt to take tea with the two little birds), and said, with a significant cough:", "sha256": "20ce2f91dcd4096e6b4f240db8fc529c38d67e0a0ecc314c32d33972099d5525", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[20]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0021", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You couldn’t speak to me without inconveniencing yourself, Trotwood, I am afraid?’", "sha256": "2e0b243fcbd030b10c043fa353a6f1a50e5726da0668dc351d1d0f0e2ffc44c4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[21]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0022", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Certainly, Mr. Dick,’ said I; ‘come in!’", "sha256": "66785ff9eaaad0d304358286b312a3523e6387ed65c7dbc849ae0a57b5fe3ae8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[22]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0023", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Trotwood,’ said Mr. Dick, laying his finger on the side of his nose, after he had shaken hands with me. ‘Before I sit down, I wish to make an observation. You know your aunt?’", "sha256": "7f2e2fdb45ebcfecfbb4728516b019e6822d4160a58eac9d019336eca824fd6c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[23]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0024", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘A little,’ I replied.", "sha256": "3e7c948d4312521fde8671380721ec266db322f7ac8c994f8014d06120a37d8b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[24]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0025", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘She is the most wonderful woman in the world, sir!’", "sha256": "664b2d9d79e7eb1c50aecef3a1ad95d53bb2002696c88ee3e7cefdb68d6d1aea", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[25]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0026", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "After the delivery of this communication, which he shot out of himself as if he were loaded with it, Mr. Dick sat down with greater gravity than usual, and looked at me.", "sha256": "fc04658fa8500d385c75c5d20d5bdd4184c228664737f03e66d22a20f3237b6e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[26]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0027", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Now, boy,’ said Mr. Dick, ‘I am going to put a question to you.’", "sha256": "c154faec579c2b11c4e7823493ed6d81fc3c827bde279e19cc3238f93dc3293b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[27]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0028", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘As many as you please,’ said I.", "sha256": "0924bc19decec8fda0e4aead1987b065c06e49d72c9daf5b70c5bf1fe3095c3d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[28]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0029", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What do you consider me, sir?’ asked Mr. Dick, folding his arms.", "sha256": "21c98a271e79a7b40cbd5a484f5c6831359f9e87a870c6813b94621e20f54e7d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[29]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0030", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘A dear old friend,’ said I. ‘Thank you, Trotwood,’ returned Mr. Dick, laughing, and reaching across in high glee to shake hands with me. ‘But I mean, boy,’ resuming his gravity, ‘what do you consider me in this respect?’ touching his forehead.", "sha256": "b9d741b6b2da77cd8210bf045010b65e71417b1fefdc8a993e114db7713f93ed", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[30]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0031", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I was puzzled how to answer, but he helped me with a word.", "sha256": "df0cc385eae2a3f44f867a98ef95d34c816e7ea4cf1859f4d905f1b385e1b6b8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[31]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
